latest.notes: Avvio can now fetch tomorrow's commercial log from your traffic system automatically each night. Turn it on in Settings, Traffic, Traffic Log and pick a time — the next day's log is fetched and imported with no preview needed. If the log isn't published yet, or that day's log hasn't been generated, it retries for about two hours and then reports; it never writes a day it can't place in full. The result of each night's run is shown in the same pane.
